verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to self-host Fastmail itself. JMAP being an open standard any organisation can implement, and the jmap.io list of third-party server implementations, are protocol-level building blocks, not a self-hostable Fastmail. The open-source page is cited by title only, with no content about self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
